map.国际戒指尺码对照(中国大陆/港码/美码/英码/日码/欧码)，输入周长或直径自动换: International ring size comparison (China mainland / Hong Kong / US / UK / Japan / EU); enter circumference or diameter for automatic conversion.
map.📖 查看「戒指尺寸对照表 使用指南」: View the Ring Size Chart User Guide
map.用细线/纸条绕手指一圈，量出长度即周长(mm)。: Wrap a thin string or strip of paper around the finger once; the measured length is the circumference (mm).
map.测量已有戒指的内圈直径(mm)。: Measure the inner diameter of an existing ring (mm).
map.手指在傍晚略粗，建议此时测量；关节较粗者需适当选大半号；冬天手指偏瘦可适当选小。: Fingers are slightly thicker in the evening, so measure then; those with thicker knuckles should choose half a size up; in winter fingers are thinner and a smaller size may fit. This table is for reference; the actual fit should be confirmed by trying on the real ring.
map.中国大陆/港码以戒指内圈周长(mm)为号(如12号=周长52mm)；美码以直径为: China mainland / Hong Kong sizes are numbered by inner circumference (mm) (e.g. size 12 = 52 mm circumference); US sizes are based on diameter; Japan sizes are circumference minus 38; EU sizes are numbered by circumference.
map.用软尺量指围算直径，对照圈号。: Measure finger circumference with a soft tape to get the diameter and match the ring number.
map.不同国家尺码体系互转。: Convert between different national sizing systems.
map.直径 = 周长 ÷ π = 55 ÷ 3.14159 ≈ 17.5mm。港码约: Diameter = circumference ÷ π = 55 ÷ 3.14159 ≈ 17.5 mm. Hong Kong size is about 14 (inner 17.5 mm); EU is often marked 55.
map.下午量更准: Measure in the afternoon for accuracy
map.手指早晚/冷热胀缩约 ±0.5 号；建议下午温暖时量，取略紧不脱落为准，宽版戒需: Fingers swell/shrink about ±0.5 size between morning/evening and with heat/cold; measure in the warm afternoon, taking a slightly snug fit that does not slip off as the standard, and add half a size for wide bands.
map.港码和欧码怎么对？: How do Hong Kong and EU sizes correspond?
map.欧码多直接标内圈周长(mm，如 55)；港码=内圈直径(mm)−? 约 14 号: EU sizes often mark the inner circumference directly (mm, e.g. 55); Hong Kong size roughly equals the inner diameter (mm) — about size 14 corresponds to 17.5 mm. Brands vary, so use the measured inner diameter.
map.量不出内径怎么办？: What if I cannot measure the inner diameter?
map.用细线绕手指一圈量周长最稳：剪一条无弹性细线绕指根一周，在重叠处做记号后拉直量长: Measuring circumference by wrapping a string around the finger is most reliable: cut a non-elastic string, wrap it around the finger base for one turn, mark the overlap, straighten and measure the length (mm) — that is the circumference; inner diameter = circumference ÷ π. Measure in the evening when the finger is thickest, and measure the finger base not the knuckle; if the knuckle is clearly thicker than the base, take the midpoint of the two values to avoid a ring that is too tight or slips off.
map.戒指尺寸对照表是一款日常生活领域的在线工具。日常生活工具，贴近生活，实用便捷。: The Ring Size Chart is an everyday online tool. Practical, life-oriented, and easy to use.
map.直径(mm) = 手指周长 ÷ π；尺码匹配：在标准尺码表（周长/直径/港码/U: Diameter (mm) = finger circumference ÷ π; size matching: take the row in the standard size table (circumference/diameter/HK/US/UK/JP/EU) with the smallest absolute circumference difference, and when |standard circumference − input circumference| >1 mm, prompt that the size falls between standard sizes and trying the two adjacent sizes is recommended. Validation: the circumference must be a valid positive number, otherwise prompt for a valid circumference; when a diameter is entered instead, convert it to circumference as d×π before matching. Criteria: the matched row is highlighted and the HK/US/UK/JP codes plus the EU size are output.
map.用软尺量指围算直径，在本表 44–70 mm 参考范围内对照圈号。: Measure the finger circumference with a soft tape and match it within this 44–70 mm table.
map.不同国家尺码体系互转；超出参考范围时只提示实测/咨询，不做端点外推。: Convert between national sizing systems; outside 44–70 mm the page only advises re-measuring or consulting a jeweller and does not extrapolate.
map.例如 75 mm 已超出本表范围，页面不再推荐端点圈号，而提示重新实测或咨询商家: For example, 75 mm is outside this table, so the page no longer recommends an end-point size and instead asks you to re-measure or consult a jeweller. When two rows are more than 1 mm apart, the two nearest actual circumferences are shown for trying on.
map.为什么不能按端点外推？: Why not extrapolate from the end points?
map.不同地区标准和品牌版型差异很大，端点外的圈号没有本表依据，按最近档位硬推可能明显: Regional standards and brand lasts vary widely, and sizes beyond the table have no basis here. Snapping to the nearest end row can be clearly too tight or too loose, so re-measure or have the jeweller confirm against the measured inner diameter.
